- [ ] 🟢 Entry-Level / Fresher (0–3 Years)

1. Core mechanics / theoretical foundation
2. Real-world edge cases / tradeoffs
3. Production code or architectural pattern

(e.g., Google, Uber, Swiggy, Apple, Revolut, etc.)
